svg.title: Agent Architecture — the eight layers (from Kapi, alpha.getkapi.com/agent-architecture)
svg.desc: The parts of an agent product, from the model outward: one agent, a graph of agents, what starts a run and where the answer goes, the screens people use, what it remembers at three scopes, the systems and data it works with, human approval and evals, what starts a run, the screens people use, and the foundations underneath, with governance around everything.
